title: NASA's Moon fact sheet: mass 0.07346×10^24 kg, revolution 27.3217 days
summary: The sheet lists the Moon's mass as 0.07346 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 1738.1 km, mean density 3344 kg/m^3, and surface gravity 1.62 m/s^2.
body: The sheet lists the Moon's mass as 0.07346 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 1738.1 km, mean density 3344 kg/m^3, and surface gravity 1.62 m/s^2. The orbital rows list a semimajor axis of 0.3844 × 10^6 km, a revolution period of 27.3217 days, and a recession rate from Earth of 3.8 cm/yr. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last updated on the page: 2024-01-11.
